title: Velo Ruby Berry Slim Nicotine Pouches
description: Velo Slim Ruby Berry Nicotine Pouches highlight the bright taste of Strawberry with a tangy note that adds depth and balance. This fruity and lightly acidic blend makes Ruby Berry a distinctive berry flavour. Each can contains 20 slim pouches made from plant-based fibres, designed for a discreet and comfortable fit under the lip. Nicotine is released gradually without smoke, vapour or odour, offering a practical choice wherever you are. Produced in Europe, Velo nicotine pouches are available in a variety of strengths and flavours. Ruby Berry is offered in three options: Mild 6mg for those who prefer a gentler nicotine dose, Medium 10mg for a balanced release, and Strong 17mg for users seeking a more potent experience. Nicotine Ranges: Mellow - 4mg to 6mg this is best for new users. Original - 6mg to 11mg this is best for regular users. Intense - 8mg to 17mg this is suited for more experienced users How to Use: Place one pouch under your upper lip and leave it in place for 20–40 minutes while the flavour and nicotine release gradually. When finished, remove the pouch and dispose of it responsibly. Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow the pouches.
